newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's hurt by new competition, weather.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's hurt by new competition, weather.

text.p: Harrah's Entertainment Inc said on Thursday that its first-quarter financial results were hurt by bad weather in northern Nevada, construction disruptions in Las Vegas and new competitive supply in the riverboat casino sector.
Lake Tahoe and nearby areas were hurt when their primary access road was closed due to bad weather, the company said, and flooding in Reno also hurt.
Operating profit in the riverboat casino division was down 28.8 percent from the same period a year ago, as many Harrah's markets absorbed new competitive supply, the company said.
Operating profits in the company's other operations improved, led by the international and Indian-gaming divisions, Harrah's said.
Harrah's reported Q1 1997 net operating income of $0.22 per share, compared to $0.30 for the same period the year before.
